common.preIncorporation: Todijo currently operates as a pre-incorporation marketplace project and service, not as an incorporated SAS. Verified company registration, VAT and registered-office details will be added after incorporation.
common.traderStatus: Todijo does not yet reliably classify or display whether each seller is a trader/professional or a private seller. Sellers must describe their status accurately. Buyer statutory rights may differ according to that status; this remains a product requirement and no status should be assumed.

terms.title: Marketplace Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Rules for using Todijo as a buyer, seller or visitor.

sections.title: Scope, accounts and eligibility
sections.body: Todijo provides a marketplace that connects independent sellers with buyers. Unless a listing expressly says otherwise, the independent seller—not Todijo—is the seller and controls its inventory. Users must be legally able to use the service, provide accurate information, secure their credentials and promptly report unauthorised access.

sections.title: Listings, orders, prices and payments
sections.body: Sellers are responsible for lawful, accurate listings, prices, variants and stock. An order is subject to availability and the applicable seller's acceptance and fulfilment. Stripe processes checkout and seller payment services where configured; Todijo does not receive full card details. Fees, taxes and payout arrangements are governed by the actual checkout and seller configuration, not invented by these terms.

sections.title: Conduct, communications and content
sections.body: Users must not commit fraud, evade security, misuse personal data, manipulate reviews, interfere with the service, sell prohibited goods or infringe intellectual-property rights. Messages, listings, images and reviews must be truthful, lawful and relevant. Users retain rights in their content while permitting Todijo to display and technically process it to operate and promote the marketplace.

sections.title: Orders, problems and responsibilities
sections.body: Buyers must check order details and cooperate on delivery or issue evidence. Sellers remain responsible for fulfilment, product conformity, customer communication and remedies required by law. Todijo may facilitate messages, issue review and platform enforcement, but does not replace a seller's legal duties. Mandatory consumer rights are not waived by these terms or by an internal order status.

sections.title: Access, availability, privacy and disputes
sections.body: Todijo may restrict or suspend accounts or content for security, illegality, serious misuse or policy breaches, with proportionate review where appropriate. The service may change or be interrupted, and liability is not excluded where law forbids exclusion. Privacy and cookies are governed by the dedicated notices. Contact Todijo through the support address below for platform disputes. Material policy updates will be published; continued use cannot remove mandatory rights.

seller.title: Marketplace Seller Terms
seller.intro: Additional responsibilities for every seller offering products through Todijo.

sections.title: Seller status and identity
sections.body: Sellers act independently from Todijo and must provide truthful identity, contact and, where applicable, business or trader information. Each seller is responsible for determining and disclosing its legal status and for registrations, tax, VAT and invoices required by that status. Todijo must not be represented as the owner or seller of independent inventory.

sections.title: Products, listings and intellectual property
sections.body: A seller may list only lawful, safe, authentic products it is entitled to sell. Descriptions, images, condition, variants, price and available stock must be accurate and kept current. Counterfeit, prohibited, restricted, unsafe or rights-infringing products are forbidden. Sellers must hold the necessary rights or permissions for text, brands and images they upload.

sections.title: Orders, fulfilment and buyers
sections.body: Sellers must review and handle orders promptly, package and ship with reasonable care, maintain truthful fulfilment updates, and communicate professionally. They are responsible for product conformity, delivery information and resolving missing, damaged, wrong or misdescribed goods. They must cooperate with legitimate cancellation, return, refund and dispute requests and preserve relevant evidence.

sections.title: Payments, tax and commercial configuration
sections.body: Stripe Connect or related Stripe onboarding may be required to receive marketplace payments. Sellers must keep payment information accurate and comply with Stripe requirements. Commission, subscription, fees and payout timing are only those shown in the active commercial configuration. Sellers remain responsible for their own tax, VAT, accounting and invoice duties according to applicable status and law.

sections.title: Reviews, enforcement and suspension
sections.body: Sellers must not manipulate reviews, pressure buyers or move transactions off-platform to evade safeguards. Todijo may remove listings, limit features, hold platform review, or suspend or terminate access for fraud, unsafe or illegal goods, intellectual-property infringement, repeated fulfilment failures or serious policy breaches. This does not remove either party's mandatory legal rights.

returns.title: Returns, Refunds & Cancellations
returns.intro: How order problems and requests are handled on the current Todijo marketplace.

sections.title: Cancellation before shipment
sections.body: A buyer may submit a cancellation request while a paid order is still in an eligible pre-shipment state. A request is not guaranteed: the seller or Todijo must review the order circumstances. Once shipment has occurred, the normal pre-shipment cancellation route is no longer appropriate, but other contractual or statutory remedies may still apply.

sections.title: Problems after delivery
sections.body: After delivery, a buyer may report a damaged or wrong item, an item not as described, missing goods or parts, or another legitimate order problem. The current account workflow accepts return or dispute requests after the order is marked delivered. Buyers should explain the problem and provide available evidence; internal status rules do not remove mandatory rights.

sections.title: Item not received
sections.body: Non-delivery should be raised in the context of the promised or reasonable shipping and delivery progress, not immediately after payment. Check tracking or seller updates where available, contact the seller, and escalate through Todijo support if the order remains unresolved. Do not mark an undelivered order as delivered merely to unlock another request route.

sections.title: Returns and refunds
sections.body: Start the available order request or contact support before returning goods. Wait for confirmed return instructions; Todijo does not promise an automatic prepaid label or a universal return address. Sellers must assess legitimate requests and applicable law. Approved refunds are processed through the original payment infrastructure where applicable. No exact bank settlement time is promised.

sections.title: Disputes and EU withdrawal rights
sections.body: If buyer and seller cannot resolve a request, it may be escalated to Todijo for platform review. Where EU consumer withdrawal rights apply, they exist independently of Todijo's internal cancellation and refund workflow. Their availability can depend on whether the seller is acting as a trader and on applicable law; no exception is created here and an order status does not extinguish a statutory right.
